answer_1.quote: We present the Respond to Help Requests (R2H) benchmark as a test-bed for automatically evaluating the capabilities of multimodal conversational navigation-helper agent, that helps task performers complete tasks by providing natural language responses to inquiries based on environment information.
answer_1.outputs: natural language responses to inquiries from the task performer

answer_2.quote: We also evaluate the ablated models with language generation metrics, BLUE2 and ROUGE-L.

answer_4.quote: We ask human testers to rate the faithfulness and naturalness of the responses evaluate the response from helper agents with automatic scores.
answer_4.guideline: Participants are asked to rate the naturalness and faithfulness of the response from the helper in the last task session.
